label: Info itself
summary: A function on the SAIValueInfo type that, going by its name, hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type and nothing about what SAIValueInfo is.

label: Access saint entry itself
summary: A function on a saint entry of the faith window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Relics remaining
summary: How many more holy relics can still be taken from this saint, as a whole number.
details: Used in the saints tab of the faith window: it is shown as the count of relics remaining, and the Extract Relic button is only enabled while it is above 0 and IsSaintActive is true for the player. At 0 the button's tooltip says the saint can yield no more relics.

label: Saint's location
summary: The place tied to the saint in the faith window's saints tab: where a living saint is from, or where a dead one is buried.
details: The window shows its name after "From" (living saint) or "Buried in" (dead saint). The window uses it as a province (it checks Province.IsValid on it) and hides the line when that province has the variable hide_location_for_saint set. The game documents no return type.

label: Saint
summary: The saint character this entry of the faith window's saints tab is about.
details: The window reads the character's name and whether they are still alive from it; the Extract Relic button only shows for a saint who is dead. The game documents no return type.

label: Is saint active
summary: Whether the saint counts as active for the given character's faith; vanilla passes the player.
details: Takes one argument, a character (vanilla writes GetPlayer.Self). When it is false the Extract Relic tooltip says the saint is not buried in a county of the player's faith (its text key calls this not venerated), and the button stays disabled. Going by that text, active means buried in a county that follows that character's faith.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose faith is checked.

label: Saint entry itself
summary: A function on a saint entry of the faith window that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Full location text
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, gives the full path of where the item is saved.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Its return type is a text. The game documents nothing more.

label: Access savable itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Error text
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, holds the error message for the item.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Its companion HasError tells whether there is one. The game documents nothing more.

label: File name
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, gives the item's file name.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has error
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal Savable item has an error.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Its return value is yes or no. The message itself would come from Error.

label: Has warning
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal Savable item has a warning.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Its return value is yes or no. The message itself would come from Warning.

label: Is deletable
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal Savable item may be deleted.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Can file name change
summary: Whether, going by its name, the file name of the engine's internal Savable item may be changed.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Can revert
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal Savable item can be set back to an earlier state.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. RevertLocation on the same type is likely what would do the reverting, but the game documents nothing more.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal Savable item is selected.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it on this type. Other types' IsSelected (for example SaveGameItem.IsSelected) are used to show a pressed button; that is only a hint.

label: Save location
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, gives where the item is saved.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The lines with the word Location in the input are plain game texts, not this function. The game documents nothing more.

label: Location tooltip
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, is the tooltip for the item's save location.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Revert location
summary: An action of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, sets the item's save location back to what it was.
details: Returns nothing, so it is meant for a button click. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Savable itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Set file name
summary: An action of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, sets the item's file name.
details: Returns nothing; the game lists no argument for it, so where the new name comes from is not documented. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set save location
summary: An action of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, sets where the item is saved.
details: Takes one argument, not documented further; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, the new location.

label: Select savable
summary: An action of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, selects or deselects the item.
details: Takes one argument, not documented further; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it on this type (GuiLaw.SetSelected is another type).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, whether it should be selected.

label: Warning text
summary: A text of the engine's internal Savable type that, going by its name, holds the warning message for the item.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Its companion HasWarning tells whether there is one.

label: Access group itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Group has error
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items has an error.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Whether it looks at the items inside the group is not documented.

label: Group has warning
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items has a warning.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. Whether it looks at the items inside the group is not documented.

label: Is group expanded
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items is opened up.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type. Other types' IsExpanded control whether a part of a list is shown; that is only a hint. ToggleExpanded on the same type would open or close it.

label: Group can revert
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items can be set back to an earlier state.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is group selected
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items is selected.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; other types' IsSelected show a pressed button, which is only a hint. IsSelectedIndeterminable on the same type suggests a group can also be partly selected.

label: Is partly selected
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal group of savable items is neither fully selected nor fully unselected.
details: Going by the name, this is the in-between state of a group checkbox when only some of its items are selected. Vanilla never uses it; the game documents nothing more.

label: Group save location
summary: A text of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, gives where the group is saved.
details: Belongs to the engine's internal GUI tools; vanilla never uses it. The lines with the word Location in the input are plain game texts, not this function.

label: Revert group location
summary: An action of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, sets the group's save location back to what it was.
details: Returns nothing, so it is meant for a button click. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Savable items
summary: Going by its name, the list of savable items in the engine's internal SavableGroup.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Group itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Set group location
summary: An action of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, sets where the group is saved.
details: Takes one argument, not documented further; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, the new location.

label: Select group
summary: An action of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, selects or deselects the group.
details: Takes one argument, not documented further; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it on this type (GuiLaw.SetSelected is another type).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, whether it should be selected.

label: Group title
summary: A text of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, is the group's heading.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type. The lines in the input name Title on other things (a landed title in decision texts) and are unrelated.

label: Open or close group
summary: An action of the engine's internal SavableGroup type that, going by its name, opens the group if it is closed and closes it if it is open.
details: Returns nothing, so it is meant for a button click. Vanilla never uses it on this type; other types' ToggleExpanded are clicked to fold list parts, which is only a hint.

label: Access dialog itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal save dialog that, going by its name, hands back the dialog itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Find group location
summary: An action of the engine's internal save dialog that, going by its name, looks for a save location for a group.
details: Takes two arguments, neither documented; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Find location
summary: An action of the engine's internal save dialog that, going by its name, looks for a save location for an item.
details: Takes two arguments, neither documented; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Groups
summary: Going by its name, the list of groups of savable items in the engine's internal save dialog.
details: Vanilla never uses it; the input's lines contain the plain word Groups in game texts. The game documents no return type.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal save dialog is selected as a whole.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; other types' IsSelected are only a hint. IsSelectedIndeterminable on the same type probably covers a partial selection.

label: Is partly selected
summary: Whether, going by its name, the engine's internal save dialog is in a state between selected and not selected.
details: Going by the name, this is the in-between state of a checkbox when only some items are selected. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Number of savables
summary: Going by its name, how many savable items the engine's internal save dialog holds, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Dialog itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal save dialog that, going by its name, hands back the dialog itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Set selected
summary: An action of the engine's internal save dialog that, going by its name, sets whether it is selected.
details: Takes one argument, not documented further; returns nothing. Vanilla never uses it on this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, whether it should be selected.

label: Save itself
summary: The save game itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The engine's save game analyzer passes it from an entry of its save list to select that save when the entry is clicked. The game documents no return type.

label: Last modified
summary: When the save game file was last changed, as text.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the Last Modified column of its save list.

label: Save name
summary: The save game's name, as text.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the Title column of its save list and as "Save Game: ..." for the save being analysed.

label: Save itself
summary: The save game itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The engine's save game analyzer passes it from an entry of its save list to check whether that save is the selected one. The game documents no return type.

label: Access view itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal save game analysis view that, going by its name, hands back the view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Block note
summary: The note written for a block of the analysed save, as text.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it as the tooltip of each row of its block list, passing that row's block. The notes are edited in the analyzer's notes view (EditNotes).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The block of the save the note is for.

label: Analysed save
summary: The save game the engine's save game analyzer is looking at.
details: The analyzer shows its name as "Save Game: ..." at the top of the analysis view. The game documents no return type.

label: Shows hidden tokens
summary: Whether the save game analyzer currently shows hidden tokens (yes or no).
details: The analyzer's Show hidden tokens checkbox shows this value; ToggleShowHidden switches it. A token is hidden from its notes view, which merges its size into its parent.

label: Is analysis view active
summary: Whether the save game analyzer is showing its analysis view (yes or no).
details: The analyzer has three views (analysis, save list and notes) and shows each view with its buttons only while that view is active.

label: Is analysis empty
summary: Whether the save game analyzer has no save loaded to show (yes or no).
details: When it is true and the analyzer is not reading, it shows "No save game loaded..".

label: Is reading save
summary: Whether the save game analyzer is still reading the save it analyses (yes or no).
details: While it is true, the analyzer shows "Analyzing save.." and its Load button is disabled.

label: View itself
summary: A function on the engine's internal save game analysis view that, going by its name, hands back the view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Sort blocks
summary: Sorts the save game analyzer's block list by the given column; it returns nothing.
details: The analyzer's column headers call it when clicked. The Percentage, Parent Percentage and Size columns all sort by 'size'.

label: Toggle hidden tokens
summary: Switches showing hidden tokens in the save game analyzer on or off; it returns nothing.
details: It is the action of the Show hidden tokens checkbox; GetShowHidden gives the current state.

label: Access analyzer itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameAnalyzer type that, going by its name, hands back the analyzer itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Cancel
summary: Leaves the save game analyzer's save list without loading a save; it returns nothing.
details: It is the action of the save list's Cancel button, which is disabled while the list is being read. Going by its name and the button, it cancels picking a save to load.

label: Close notes
summary: Closes the save game analyzer's notes view; it returns nothing.
details: Its button reads Discard when the notes have unsaved changes and Close when they have none, so unsaved changes are dropped. Saving is done with the Save button instead.

label: Edit notes
summary: Opens the save game analyzer's notes view for one token (key) of the save; it returns nothing.
details: The "..." button on each block row calls it with that block's token name. The notes view lets the user write a note and hide the token.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The token name the notes are for.
fields.values: a token name, as from GetTokenName

label: List saves
summary: Opens the save game analyzer's list of save games to choose one from; it returns nothing.
details: It is the action of the analysis view's Load button, which is disabled while a save is being read.

label: Load selected save
summary: Loads the save selected in the save game analyzer's list for analysis; it returns nothing.
details: It is the action of the Load Selected button, which works only when a save is selected and the list is not being read.

label: Analyzer itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameAnalyzer type that, going by its name, hands back the analyzer itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access block itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameBlockData type that, going by its name, hands back the block entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Block size
summary: How many text characters a block of the analysed save takes up, as a whole number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the Size column of its block list.

label: Instance count
summary: Going by its name, how many times this block appears in the save file, as a whole number.
details: Part of the save game analysis types; vanilla never uses it.

label: Other paths
summary: A text listing the other places in the save where a block with this token is found.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it as the tooltip of the Other Paths column, whose number comes from GetOtherPathsCount.

label: Other paths count
summary: How many other places in the save a block with this token is found, as a whole number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the Other Paths column; the tooltip lists them (GetOtherPaths).

label: Share of parent
summary: What share of its parent block a block of the analysed save takes up, as a decimal number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it as a percent in the Parent Percentage column.

label: Block path
summary: Going by its name, the path of this block inside the save file.
details: Part of the save game analysis types; vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Share of save
summary: What share of the whole save a block takes up, as a decimal number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it as a percent in the Percentage column. GetParentPercentage gives the share of the parent block instead.

label: Block title
summary: The heading shown for a block of the analysed save, as text.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the first column of its block list, headed Token Name.

label: Token name
summary: The token (the key that starts the block) of a block of the analysed save, as text.
details: The engine's save game analyzer passes it to EditNotes from each row's "..." button, so notes are kept per token.

label: Whitespace size
summary: How many blank characters (spaces, tabs, line breaks) a block of the analysed save contains, as a whole number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it in the Whitespace Size column.

label: Whitespace ratio
summary: What share of a block of the analysed save is blank characters, as a decimal number.
details: The engine's save game analyzer shows it as a percent in the Whitespace Ratio column.

label: Block itself
summary: The save block entry itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The engine's save game analyzer passes it from each row of its block list to GetNote to show that block's note. The game documents no return type.

label: Access view itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameConfigView type that, going by its name, hands back the view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Token name
summary: The token (key) whose notes the save game analyzer's notes view is editing, as text.
details: The notes view shows it as its heading, above the note box and the checkbox to hide the token.

label: Is notes view active
summary: Whether the save game analyzer is showing its notes view (yes or no).
details: The analyzer shows the notes view and its buttons (Save, Discard or Close) only while this is true.

label: Has unsaved changes
summary: Whether the save game analyzer's notes view has changes that are not saved yet (yes or no).
details: While it is true, the Save button is enabled and the close button reads Discard; otherwise the close button reads Close.

label: Save notes
summary: An action of the save game analyzer's notes view that saves the changes made there.
details: The save game analyzer is an engine debug tool that shows which parts of a save file take up the most space. Its notes view has a Save button that calls this; the button is only enabled while the view has unsaved changes (IsDirty), and the view offers to hide a token so its size is merged into its parent. Returns nothing.

label: View itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameConfigView type that, going by its name, hands back the view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access save entry itself
summary: A function on a save game entry of the load and save lists that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Can earn achievements
summary: Whether achievements can still be earned when playing on from this save.
details: The load screen shows an achievements-allowed icon when it is true and a not-allowed one when it is false. When it is false but no game rule blocks achievements (HasAchievementBlockingGameRules is false), the save entry shows a separate not-allowed icon; a comment in the GUI file names tag switching, console, multiplayer and a modified checksum as such other reasons.

label: Rules blocking achievements
summary: A text that lists the game rules of this save that stop achievements from being earned.
details: Shown as text and as a tooltip on the load screen and on the main menu's save entry.

label: Coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms stored with the save, shown on the main menu's save entry and in the shared save-entry emblem.
details: The interface draws it at a chosen size with GetTexture or GetSlot. Vanilla puts it inside the mask of the player's government (GetPlayerGovernment) and a frame chosen by GetPlayerTier. HasCoatOfArms tells whether there is one. The game does not say whose arms it is.

label: Game date
summary: The date stored with the save, most likely the in-game date at which it was made.
details: The load screen shows it as "Date: ..." through GetString, and the main menu's Continue tooltip lists it too. That it is the in-game date is an inference from the label and from GetLastPlayed being the other time shown; the game documents no return type.

label: House emblem frame
summary: Which frame picture to use around the house coat of arms of the save, as a whole number.
details: Used as the frame index of the house emblem in the shared coat of arms templates, together with GetSaveGameItemHouseCoAFrame as the picture.

label: House coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of the house stored with the save.
details: Vanilla asks for it at 88 by 88 and draws it in a 44 by 44 icon in the shared coat of arms templates, with the house mask, offset and scale from the GetSaveGameItemHouseCoA functions and a frame from GetDynastyFrame.

label: House name
summary: The name of the house stored with the save.
details: The load screen shows it as "House: …".

label: Last played
summary: A text saying when the save was last played.
details: Shown as "Last played: …" in the load list.

label: Main character portrait
summary: A portrait picture of the save's main character, for the load screen.
details: Takes four arguments; vanilla passes a portrait environment ('environment_body'), a camera ('camera_body'), the widget's size and '(bool)no'. What the last one switches is not documented. The portrait is only shown when HasMainCharacter is true.

label: Missing DLC info
summary: A text naming the DLCs the save uses that are not active now.
details: Shown as text and tooltip on the load screen and as a tooltip on the main menu's save entry. HasMissingDLCs tells whether any are missing.

label: Missing mods
summary: A text naming the mods the save was played with that are not active now.
details: Shown as a tooltip on the load screen. HasMissingMods tells whether any are missing.

label: Modified date
summary: A text that, going by its name, gives when the save file was last changed.
details: Vanilla never uses it; the load list shows GetLastPlayed instead.

label: Save file name
summary: The save's file name, as shown in the load list.
details: The load screen shows it as "Filename: …", and the main menu's Continue tooltip starts with it.

label: Number of players
summary: How many players the save has, as a whole number.
details: Used in the tooltip "Multiplayer Save (… players)".

label: Player's government
summary: The government type of the player in the save.
details: The main menu's save entry takes the realm frame, mask, offset and scale for the coat of arms from it, so the emblem looks right for that government.

label: Player character name
summary: The name of the character the player plays in the save.
details: Shown in the load screen's details and in the main menu's Continue tooltip.

label: Player's title tier
summary: The rank of the player's title in the save, as a whole number.
details: Used as the frame index of the realm frame and its top frame around the save's coat of arms, so the frame follows the tier of the player's title.

label: House emblem frame picture
summary: The frame picture drawn around the house coat of arms of the save.
details: Used as the texture of the house emblem frame in the shared coat of arms templates; GetDynastyFrame picks which frame of it to show. The game documents no return type.

label: House emblem mask
summary: The mask that gives the house coat of arms of the save its outline shape.
details: Used as the coat of arms mask of the house emblem in the shared coat of arms templates. The game documents no return type.

label: House emblem offset
summary: How far the house coat of arms of the save is shifted inside its mask, as a pair of numbers.
details: Used as the coat of arms offset of the house emblem in the shared coat of arms templates.

label: House emblem scale
summary: How much the house coat of arms of the save is scaled inside its mask, as a pair of numbers.
details: Used as the coat of arms scale of the house emblem in the shared coat of arms templates.

label: Player's title name
summary: The name of the player's title in the save.
details: Shown in the load screen's details (with the first letter made upper case) and in the main menu's Continue tooltip.

label: Game version
summary: The name of the game version the save was made with.
details: The load screen shows it as "Version: …". IsDifferentVersion tells whether it differs from the running game.

label: Rules block achievements
summary: Whether the save uses game rules that stop achievements from being earned.
details: The load screen shows a notice when it is true; GetAchievementBlockingGameRulesInfo names the rules.

label: Has coat of arms
summary: Whether the save has a coat of arms to show.
details: The save-entry emblem shows the coat of arms and crown when it is true and a fallback when it is false.

label: Has house coat of arms
summary: Whether, going by its name, the save has a house coat of arms to show.
details: Vanilla never uses it; the house emblem is drawn with GetHouseCoatOfArms.

label: Has main character
summary: Whether the save has a main character whose portrait can be shown.
details: The load screen shows the large portrait from GetMainCharacterTexture only when it is true.

label: Has missing DLC
summary: Whether the save uses DLCs that are not active now.
details: While it is true the load screen disables a button (vanilla: enabled when it is false) and shows the warning "Missing DLC"; GetMissingDLCInfo names them.

label: Has missing mods
summary: Whether the save was played with mods that are not active now.
details: The load screen then shows the warning "Missing Mods"; GetMissingMods names them. Unlike missing DLC, vanilla does not disable a button for it.

label: Has character to show
summary: Whether the save has a character whose details can be shown on the load screen.
details: The load screen shows the box with the player's name, house, title and date only when it is true.

label: Is cloud save
summary: Whether the save is stored in the cloud.
details: The load list then shows a cloud icon, and the Continue tooltip adds "Cloud Save".

label: Is other game version
summary: Whether the save was made with a different game version than the one running.
details: The load screen then shows the warning "Different version".

label: Is Ironman save
summary: Whether the save is an Ironman save.
details: The load list and the main menu's save entry then show the Ironman icon.

label: Is multiplayer save
summary: Whether the save comes from a multiplayer game.
details: The load list then shows the multiplayer icon.

label: Is save selected
summary: Whether this save is the one selected in the load list.
details: Vanilla shows the entry's button as pressed while it is true; Select picks it.

label: Is valid save
summary: Whether the save file is valid.
details: When it is false the load list shows an invalid-save icon with the tooltip "Invalid savegame. Might cause crashes." The save window hides invalid saves unless the player ticks Show invalid.

label: Select save
summary: Makes this save the selected one in the load list.
details: Returns nothing; vanilla calls it when the entry is clicked. IsSelected then becomes true for it.

label: Save entry itself
summary: A function on a save game entry of the load and save lists that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Saves
summary: The list of save files shown in the save game analyzer's list view.
details: The save game analyzer is an engine debug tool for looking at what takes up space in a save. Vanilla fills the list of save rows from it and shows "No saves found.." when it is empty and the saves are no longer being read. The game documents no return type.

label: Access list itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameListView type that, going by its name, hands back the list view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Has a save selected
summary: Whether a save is selected in the save game analyzer's list.
details: Vanilla enables the "Load Selected" button only when a save is selected and the list is not still reading the saves. The save game analyzer is an engine debug tool.

label: Is list view shown
summary: Whether the save game analyzer is showing its list of saves.
details: The analyzer has three views (the analysis, the list of saves and the notes); vanilla shows the list view and its buttons only while this is yes. IsActive on other types is unrelated.

label: Is reading saves
summary: Whether the save game analyzer is still reading the list of save files.
details: While it is yes, vanilla shows "Reading saves.." and disables the "Load Selected" and "Cancel" buttons.

label: Is save selected
summary: Whether the save given in brackets is the one selected in the save game analyzer's list.
details: Vanilla uses it for the check mark of each save row, as IsSelected(SaveGame.Self). It takes one argument: the save to check.

label: List itself
summary: A function on the SaveGameListView type that, going by its name, hands back the list view itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Select save
summary: Selects the save given in brackets in the save game analyzer's list.
details: Vanilla calls it when a save row is clicked, as SetSelected(SaveGame.AccessSelf). Returns nothing.

label: Sort saves
summary: Sorts the save game analyzer's list of saves by the column named in brackets.
details: Vanilla's column header buttons call it with 'title' (the Title column) and 'last_modified' (the Last Modified column). Returns nothing.

label: Cloud save setting
summary: The cloud save part of the save window, which the save-to-cloud checkbox is built on.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data of the cloud save checkbox next to the label for saving to the cloud. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the save window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close save window
summary: Closes the save window without saving.
details: Vanilla calls it from the full-window background button and the Cancel button; the Cancel button is disabled while a save is being written.

label: Suggested save name
summary: The name the save window suggests for the new save.
details: It fills the name field when the window opens; the player can change it.

label: Existing saves
summary: The list of existing saves shown in the save window.
details: Each entry is a save game entry; invalid ones are hidden unless Show invalid is ticked. The game documents no return type.

label: Is Ironman game
summary: Whether the game being saved is an Ironman game.
details: The save button's text uses it: for a new save it reads as starting an Ironman save when true and as a plain Save when false.

label: Would overwrite
summary: Whether saving now would overwrite an existing save.
details: The save button then reads "Overwrite" instead of Save.

label: Is save name valid
summary: Whether the name typed in the save window can be used.
details: When it is false the window shows an invalid-file-name notice and the save button is disabled.

label: Is saving
summary: Whether the game is writing the save right now.
details: While it is true the save and cancel buttons are disabled and a saving indicator is shown.

label: Shows invalid saves
summary: Whether the save window currently lists invalid saves too.
details: It is the state of the Show invalid checkbox; ToggleShowInvalid switches it.

label: Save game
summary: Saves the game under the name typed in the save window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the save button and when Enter is pressed in the name field. The button is only enabled while the name is valid and no save is being written.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the save window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Toggle invalid saves
summary: Switches the save window between listing invalid saves and hiding them.
details: Vanilla calls it from the Show invalid checkbox; IsShowInvalid reads the current state.
